modules (debt collection, BPO, insurance, emergency response, Sales), a new look with three styles to choose from, AI that serves customers on chat, the Money view with Autopilot, and Claude as an AI model.

Debt collection module (add-on): accounts, promises to pay, payments, holds, arrangements with instalments and DebiCheck debit orders (NuPay, Netcash or Hyphen), the desk Account panel, reports, smart lists, journeys, and starter lists and diallers, all in its own Collections hub.

BPO module (add-on): client contracts with targets, billable outcomes and pause reasons, a client scorecard, reports grouped by client, and a Clients hub with a dashboard, tiles, contract alerts and a starter set.

Insurance module (add-on): policies and lives imported from the insurer's file, a Policy panel on the agent desk, book, lapse and persistency reports, and an Insurance hub with its own dashboard and wallboard.

Emergency and response module (add-on): emergency lines answered first, incidents with milestones on a response board, and triage cards for agents.

Sales module: Sales now has its own hub, sales can be verified with a voice-logged sale, and Real-time shows each agent's sales, target, sales still to go, % of target and sales per logged-in hour.

Every module is off until it is switched on for a tenant, and keeps its lists, campaigns, journeys, dashboards and reports inside its own hub.

A new look: Clay is the new default (warm page, rounded buttons, raised cards, new icons) across the console, the agent desk and the sign-in page. Two more looks, Soft and Today, can be chosen in Branding, and a tenant can pick its own in Settings.

AI on chats: the chat AI can verify a customer with an emailed code, email their unpaid Xero invoices, and book a queue callback. It answers only from your knowledge base and ends the chat when asked. Connect one or more Xero organisations under Integrations.

Money and Autopilot: see what made you money (value and cost per call, outcome and team), get a Monday money brief by email, and let Autopilot make small, reversible changes within your limits, with a change log, an undo and a kill switch.

Yaxxa AI: Claude can now be chosen as the AI model.

WhatsApp: voice notes play on the desk, reactions show as a line instead of a blank message, and authentication templates use Meta's own format, with Meta's reason shown when it refuses a template.

Partner Academy: debt collection courses for selling and setting it up; TalentLMS and other learning systems can connect from a one-time registration link; update courses open from the platform course list.

Workforce: agents are told when a manager adds, changes or removes an exception or records their leave, and after-hours shifts over a date range are emailed to the recipients and the agents on them.

Also new: a Google review invite on survey answers (a link per queue, sent once per call), the Grafana pack with 12 more panels, public legal pages (terms, privacy, data deletion), queue availability for warm transfers, instant hover labels on the menu icons, customer search by email domain, and a Dropdown editor with a preview in Script Builder.

Fixes: the flow designer names the step behind each problem in plain words, the desk fits one screen, INFO notice emails send again (they had failed since 2026-10-13), deletes in the admin pages no longer show an error, and after-hours shift times use the tenant's own locale.

Install: the sign-in theme changes (Keycloak brand-v7.css ships with the release). Database migrations: 9000, 9060, 9070, 9090, 9110 debt collection; 9040 Xero and 9040 after-hours shifts; 9080 LTI registrations; 9100 Google review link; 9200–9206 Money and Autopilot; 9250 BPO; 9260 module columns; 9261 tenant look; 9300 insurance; 9800 and 9801 emergency response; 9900–9902 and 9910 Sales. All are additive and already applied on staging."}
